questions.question:
Vineet, Rajesh and Kriti have different amount of money with them, Rajesh has just double the amount of money than Vineet. The total amount of money that Rajesh and Kriti have is Rs. 147. Kriti has Rs. 6 more than the amount Vineet has.

How much money does Kriti have?
questions.solution:
Suppose Vineet has Rs. x.

Rajesh has Rs. 2x.

Kriti has Rs. x + 6.

(2x) + (x + 6) = 147

3x + 6 = 147

3x = 141

x = 47

Vineet has Rs. 47.

Kriti has 47 + 6 = Rs. 53

Hence, 53 is the correct answer.

questions.question: In certain code language, ‘CAUGHT’ is coded as ‘326212087’. How will ‘SOLDER’ be coded as in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e1a2f0dc142ecfb544963c2209981c3e759d0cf81e91577dd86d50c0a2dc835.png] 

The logic followed here is,

For C, U and H → Positional value of same letter → C = 3, U = 21 & H = 8

For A, G and T → Positional values of opposite letter → A = 26, G = 20 & T = 7

Therefore, CAUGHT → 326212087

Similarly,

For S, L and E → Positional value of same letter → S = 19, L = 12 & E = 5

For O, D and R → Positional values of opposite letter → O = 12, D = 23 & R = 9

Therefore, SOLDER → 1912122359

Hence, 1912122359 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the dice that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a745d97ad0e155542251593999fa744cade7de35fb9efaa425d4dc835c5afa83.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c319fa47e20cf4b1dc377466383b45ae501d1dedd98a41013703be56cbd0d8e5.png]
questions.solution:
__**Elimination method**__

 
• Faces ***5 and 6 will lie on the opposite sides*** of the given dice. Therefore, ***figure B cannot be formed***. Thus ***options 1 and 3 are eliminated.***
 
• Faces ***2 and 3 will lie on opposite sides*** of the given dice. Therefore, ***figure C cannot be formed.*** Thus ***option 4 is eliminated which makes us conclude that figure D cannot be formed.***
 
• ⇒ ***only figure A can be formed.***
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

questions.question: ‘Vertebrate’ is related to ‘Monkey’ in the same way as ‘Invertebrate’ is related to ‘______’
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

__
 
• Monkey is a vertebrate
 
• Similarly, Starfish is an invertebrate.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Starfish'.**

 [IMAGE: https://www.vedantu.com/question-sets/ae55466c-32eb-48e0-a7c7-cee441d4da34271320874515511986.png] 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

Vertebrates have fully developed vertebral columns. 

 
• They have a proper skeletal structure.
 
• Example- humans, birds, snakes, frogs.

Invertebrate animals are those which do not develop a vertebral column.

 
• Example- insects like cockroach, flatworm, earthworm, crabs, snails, etc.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

4 : 69 ∷ 11 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is,

4 → 4³ = 64 → 64 + 5 = 69

Similarly,

11 → 11³ = 1331 → 1331 + 5 = 1336

Hence, 1136 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements:

**Statements:**

1. Some papers are copies

2. No copy is an eraser.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some copies are papers

II. Some papers are erasers.

III. No paper is an eraser.

options.text: Only Conclusion II and either conclusion I or III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusion I and either conclusion II or III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The logical Venn diagram according to given statements is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21a7bbd86b9af2cdd4de038fb8b254c3b9d18f7029a3fe147731066e3017e2e1.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some copies are papers → True (Some papers are copies)

II. Some papers are erasers. → False (it is possible but not definite)

III. No paper is an eraser. → False (it is possible but not definite)

Thus, II and III form a complementary pair.

Therefore, only conclusion I and either conclusion II or III follows.

Hence, option 3 is correct answer.
